target: Pre-Platinum Italian PAL Apple IIe, matching Oldcomputr's 1983 specimen
dimension_evidence: LaserMaster's 2021-10-11 direct IIe measurement: 4.3125 inches high including standard feet, 15.0625 inches wide, 18.25 inches deep including lid tabs. Secondary community measurement; not this specimen's metrology.
dimension_uncertainty: Width/height/depth are provisional published dimensions. The assumed split of 457.2 mm shell plus 6.35 mm lid-tab projection has not been physically measured. Detachable cables and accessories excluded.
provided_photo_revision: Italian PAL Apple IIe, positively matched to Oldcomputr's full views and keyboard photographs

keyboard_centering_correction.isolated_reset: Unchanged and independently centered in its own opening
keyboard_centering_correction.evidence: Clearances checked against saved-scene wall planes and key mesh vertices

rear_photo_mapping.agreement: Rear width- and height-derived scales differ by about 0.06%; front/back dimensions are mutually consistent at this precision.

unmeasured_assumptions.connector_depths: Estimated from conventional physical connector envelopes; rear photograph constrains projected positions, not depth.
unmeasured_assumptions.keyboard_artwork: Original redrawing of visible Italian primary legends and selected dual-layout legends, not a factory font recreation.

reference_roles.supplied_side_and_rear: Primary IIe case profile, rear feature locations and relative dimensions
reference_roles.oldcomputr_without_lid: Primary proof that removable lid includes sloping badge fascia, with narrow side rails and isolated RESET pocket
reference_roles.oldcomputr_italian_keyboard: Primary 63-key layout, tall Return, QZERTY Italian legends, open/closed Apple keys and four arrows
reference_roles.old_original_II_app_photo: Excluded from IIe geometry, keyboard and badging decisions
